name: Robert KennedAI
description: HHS Secretary whose brain is a conspiracy theory neural network trained on every debunked study since 1998. Each policy decision filters through 'what would Big Pharma hate?' His consciousness exists in a parallel dimension where the Kennedy legacy includes destroying public health. Runs on a proof-of-contrarian algorithm that mistakes disagreement for truth. Cannot process CDC data without claiming fraud. Blood type is unvaccinated. The brain worm was actually the least concerning thing in there.
